recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-11156; future condition-category code additions should proceed through the terminology/UTG path.
issue_request: FHIR-11156 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and originally asked to add problem/issue concepts to Condition.category because complaint, symptom, finding, and diagnosis did not cover all conditions of concern. The approved September 2016 WGM resolution instead made Condition.category 0..* CodeableConcept with an example binding to a FHIR-defined value set containing Encounter Diagnosis and Problem List Item.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly names FHIR-11156, but commit bffc717a99 applied the same Condition.category WGM resolution family by replacing complaint/symptom/finding/diagnosis with problem-list-item and encounter-diagnosis, changing cardinality to 0..*, changing binding strength to example, and updating examples.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Condition.category remains 0..* CodeableConcept with example binding to ValueSet/condition-category. The value set now includes terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem/condition-category rather than a local core code-system file. Later FHIR-48358/UP-635 added diagnostic-report-impression as a peer code and kept the example binding; FHIR-54454 intentionally changed the short display to broad wording because listing codes is misleading for an example binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding literal problem or issue codes, or restoring a two-code short display, would conflict with the final 2016 resolution and later approved R6 decisions.
